description: This file implements the registerizer component for tensor expression optimization in PyTorch JIT, including classes and functions for analyzing and replacing tensor buffer accesses to enable scalar replacement and registerization.

classes.name: AccessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about tensor buffer accesses, including load/store details, costs, and overlap detection.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Manages a scope of tensor buffer accesses, including open and closed accesses, and scope merging.

classes.name: RegisterizerAnalysis
classes.description: Analyzes tensor buffer accesses within code blocks, handling scope management, hoisting, and overlap detection.

classes.name: RegisterizerReplacer
classes.description: Performs the actual replacement of tensor buffer accesses with scalar variables based on analysis.

methods.name: registerize
methods.description: Main function to perform scalar replacement and registerization on a given statement.
